name: Fast Access Network
summary: Gold Coast dial-up ISP + helpdesk (1995-2000), founded by David Hughes at Bond University; acquired Mar 2000 by Asia Online Ltd (7th Australian acquisition, QLD).

events.details: Founded Jan 1995 by David Hughes; grew to helpdesk operation with dedicated staff (Geoff Leff Jan 1996). Informal operation by 1994-95 QAUUG/Bond University.

Acquired by Hong Kong-based Asia Online Ltd as its seventh Australian ISP (Queensland), reported 16 Mar 2000. Share sale agreement 22 Feb 2000: Fast Access Network Pty Ltd (ACN 070 043 131) to Asia Online-Australia Pty Ltd (ACN 089 444 691), A$2,342,500 + 208,600 Class C shares.
